arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Paul Clement argued the case differs from previous detention disputes.
He emphasized the specific legal questions raised by Padilla.
Ms. Martinez argued the nation remains governed by the rule of law.
She stated the government seeks unlimited presidential detention power. She argued Congress must define detention parameters first.
